correctness.rationale: For p≥5, the Vandermonde independence of four fourth powers of distinct binary linear forms forces 3 pair-partitions × 4×4 roots of -1, hence exactly 48 lines. Intersections within a family give 24 ordinary fourfold points, across families 192 distinct nodes, giving p_a=192+24*6-48+1=289. The normalization incidence graph has 264 vertices, 480 branches and first Betti 217, while each 4-fold local principal-unit quotient contributes 3 additive dimensions giving U dimension72 (truncated logarithm valid p≥5). If q≡1 mod8 all lines and points are fixed, so torus split rank217; otherwise Frobenius freely swaps vertices/edges in connected graph, quotient b1=109 and the integral 2-cover lemma gives Z_+ ⊕ Z[C2]^108, hence G_m×(Res_{q²/q} G_m)^108, not just rational isogeny. Lang plus prime-to-p splitting gives claimed J(F_q) abstract groups. Normalization zeta correction yields #D(F_q^n)=48q^n−216 if q^n≡1 mod8, else 0. Independent F17 enumeration recovered 192 nodes,24 fourfold points and #D(F17)=600; characteristic-five original checker source also inspected, but not independently rerun.
residual_risks: The connected regular-double-cover integral lattice lemma is necessary; rational eigenspace dimensions alone would not prove torus isomorphism.
Characteristic 3 and characteristic 2 are excluded; only divisor D, not ambient Fermat K3 zeta.
